skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand basic concepts of natural resource policy and policy analysis.
Apply methods and techniques for analyzing natural resource policies.
Analyze land resource policies and their scientific foundations.
Examine forest resource policies and their scientific foundations.
Evaluate water resource policies and their scientific foundations.
Assess marine resource policies and their scientific foundations.
Analyze mineral resource policies and their scientific foundations.
Understand principles and bases for resource planning.
Enhance ability to learn independently and conduct research.
Develop skills to present findings effectively.
Improve ability to work collaboratively in groups.
